workflow: Manual data entry of invoice details from scanned PDFs into QuickBooks
trigger: Receipt of vendor invoices via email or mail
current_workaround: Clerk manually types invoice number, date, amount, and line items from PDF into QuickBooks
consequence: Errors in data entry lead to payment delays and vendor disputes; takes 2-3 hours daily

workflow: Manual export of leads from Salesforce and import into Mailchimp for email campaigns
current_workaround: Manager exports CSV from Salesforce, cleans columns, then imports into Mailchimp
consequence: Leads are missed or duplicated; campaign timing slips; takes 4-5 hours per week

workflow: Monthly consolidation of sales data from multiple spreadsheets into a single report
current_workaround: Analyst copies data from 12 regional Excel files into a master workbook, applies formulas, and formats charts
consequence: Errors in copy-paste cause incorrect revenue figures; takes 2 full days each month

workflow: Manual reconciliation of bank transactions against QuickBooks entries
current_workaround: Bookkeeper prints bank statement, checks each transaction against QuickBooks, marks cleared items
consequence: Missed discrepancies lead to overdrafts or incorrect tax filings; takes 6-8 hours per month

workflow: Manual transfer of task updates from Trello to Asana for cross-team visibility
current_workaround: Coordinator reads Trello cards and manually creates/updates corresponding Asana tasks
consequence: Information lag causes missed deadlines; takes 1-2 hours daily
